title: Job Failure - eam-transformer-glue-job (error file present)
description: Standard remediation for the eam-transformer-glue-job. This job is diagnosed entirely from S3, not CloudWatch: when a run fails, the failed file is moved into the error/ folder of eamtransformerbucket-01. The presence of any file in that error/ folder is itself the failure signal - there is no step number or log content to parse. Once a file is confirmed present, its extension is also checked: this job only accepts .csv, so a non-.csv file present in error/ is classified separately (wrong-format notification) from a .csv file present in error/ (generic job-failure review). This job has no safe auto-remediation action either way; every match requires a human to review and decide how to proceed.
match_rule:
Check whether the keyword bucket's (eamtransformerbucket-01) error/ folder currently contains one or more files - this alone is the failure signal, not a diagnosis of root cause. Once one or more files are confirmed present, check their file extension: if any file present is NOT .csv, that is a distinct match (wrong file format) from the case where all files present are .csv. There is no step number or log file to evaluate - only presence, then extension.

Example (wrong format - MATCHES the wrong-format rule): Bucket: eamtransformerbucket-01, Folder: error/, Files: product_catalog_20260716.dat -> one file present and it is NOT .csv -> action: manual_review, HUMAN, with a wrong-format notification email asking for a .csv file to be uploaded to proceed.

example_log_events.description: Correct format - a .csv file landed in the error/ folder after a failed run (matches the generic review rule)
example_log_events.raw_event:
Bucket: eamtransformerbucket-01
Folder: error/
Files: product_catalog_20260716.csv
example_log_events.why: One or more files are present in error/ and all of them are .csv (the expected format) - the failure is job-related, not a format mistake, so this triggers the generic human-intervention review.

example_log_events.description: Wrong format - a non-.csv file landed in the error/ folder (matches the wrong-format rule)
example_log_events.raw_event:
Bucket: eamtransformerbucket-01
Folder: error/
Files: product_catalog_20260716.dat
example_log_events.why: One or more files are present in error/ and at least one of them is NOT .csv - this job only accepts .csv, so instead of the generic review notice, send a wrong-format email stating the format is incorrect and asking for a .csv file to be uploaded to proceed.

decision_tree.name: Check the eam-transformer-glue-job error/ folder for pending files, then check their format
decision_tree.instruction: List the error/ folder of the keyword bucket (eamtransformerbucket-01). If it contains one or more files, check each file's extension. Apply the matching condition below, wrong-format first.

conditions.if: one or more files exist in the keyword bucket's error/ folder AND at least one of them has an extension other than .csv
conditions.note: Wrong file format detected in error/ - this job only accepts .csv. Send a human-notification email stating that the uploaded file is in the wrong format and asking for a .csv file to be uploaded to proceed. Do not send the generic job-failure review email for this case - the format mismatch is the more specific and more useful signal.

conditions.if: one or more files exist in the keyword bucket's error/ folder AND all of them are .csv
conditions.note: Any file present in error/ means the job failed and left unprocessed data behind. This job has no safe automated fix - send a human-intervention email stating that a file is present in the error folder and needs manual review.

feedback_notes: Unlike SOP-EAM-MMSO-701, this job has no step-number threshold and no safe auto-retry/file-move action - the mere presence of a file in error/ is sufficient to require human review, by design (auto_resolvable is false so every match always routes to a human regardless of confidence). File format (.csv required) is the one sub-classification this SOP does make: a non-.csv file present in error/ gets a distinct wrong-format notification email instead of the generic review email, since that's a data-entry mistake the uploader can fix themselves rather than a job-logic issue needing investigation. Do not add an automated retry or file-move action for this job without updating this SOP and getting sign-off.
